customer_reply:
Hello,

You can delegate your approvals by following these steps:

1. Open your profile menu and select 'Out of Office'.
2. Choose a delegate with the same or higher approval limit.
3. Set the start and end dates. Delegation ends automatically on the end date.
4. Optional: tick 'Notify delegate' to send an email to the delegate.

Please note that delegation applies to documents routed to you during the selected dates. Documents already pending before the start date will remain in your queue unless you reassign them manually via Workflow > Pending.

Support Team
